errors.evidence: The description states the unit for the y-axis is "个" (items), but this unit is not explicitly written on the chart. The y-axis label is just "义项数量" (quantity of word senses).
The description uses the term "近似值" (approximate values) but then proceeds to list the exact numerical values that are displayed on top of each bar.

The description fails to mention the overall visual trend in the data. The bar heights generally decrease as the x-axis value increases, although not strictly monotonically. The prompt suggests describing trends as an option.
